anomalies.description: At ~18.5s, a bright flash appears near the street (left side), followed immediately by severe camera shake and motion blur in subsequent frames (19.0s–19.5s), consistent with an explosive impulse such as gunfire or a nearby discharge. No person is clearly visible falling or scattering, but the sudden flash and violent camera disturbance strongly suggest a shooting event, matching the expected anomaly pattern of people dropping/collapsing or panic without visible contact.
